start_here: Say to your AI: "Grant my project folder for change, then run tool:add-a-tool-to-a-project with project . and tool content-identity from my registry tools-in-this-registry.json." It copies the folder into trillion/content-identity/ and writes its line in trillion/where-each-tool-comes-from.json.
no_lists_because: This tool copies files into the granted project folder and writes the project's own record file; it reads and keeps no list rows.
instructions: 1. Grant the project's folder (the folder holding its package.json) for change, and keep a registry file tools-in-this-registry.json there or give its https address.

2. Ask your AI to run tool:add-a-tool-to-a-project with {"project":".","tool":"content-identity","from":"tools-in-this-registry.json"}. Add as when the name is already another source's folder; add prepare false to skip the cards' prepare commands.

3. Read added, already and refused. A refused edited-copy carries the diff of what you changed; move a copy to a newer commit with the sync tool, never by adding again. Commit the new trillion/ folders and the record file in your project.
